flags: The cache lacks road construction or designation history; the overview uses the documented history of the ferry connection instead. MassDOT map text interleaves columns; its Chappaquiddick description is retained without adding endpoint precision.
Material places Edgartown at strip mile 4.01; the story uses the ferry-first approach from Edgartown, then Mytoi and the separate Cape Poge excursion. Full local road junction order is not supplied.
Mytoi is intentionally short because its cache page contains only a few relevant facts.

Dropped the current claim that widow’s walks were handier for chimney fires than watching sails: the cache supports chimney access and questions the lookout story, but does not establish that comparison. Replaced it with documented village architecture.
Lighthouse tours, hike access and ferry operations have no managing-agency/operator cache confirmation. No schedules, tours, overland crossing or current shoreline connection are promised.
